newsitem.title: USA: Rohatyn considered top contender for France post.
newsitem.headline: Rohatyn considered top contender for France post.

text.p: New York investment banker Felix Rohatyn is considered the leading contender to be nominated as the next U.S. ambassador to France, U.S. officials said on Saturday.

Rohatyn would fill the position left vacant by Pamela Harriman, who suffered a stroke and died in Paris on Feb. 5. If President Bill Clinton picks him, his nomination would require Senate confirmation.
The White House last year had floated the pro-growth Rohatyn for a vacant vice chairman's seat on the Federal Reserve Board, but withdrew his name in the face of Senate Republican opposition.
